title: cairndex.yaml
description: Root config for the cairndex directory-index generator. See README.md for the reasoning behind each key.

version.description: Schema version this build accepts. A build refuses anything else rather than guessing.

mode.description: direct: cairndex writes index.{json,csv,html} itself. hugo: cairndex writes one _index.md per directory and Hugo renders the formats from that single source.

base_path.description: Where the indexed tree is mounted in the site, if not at the root. Authoritative for links a template cannot otherwise derive, such as behind a reverse proxy.

out.description: Where the indexes are written. May equal root (indexes land beside the files), a sibling directory, or a subdirectory of root (skipped when walking).

index_basename.description: Filename stem for a directory's own page and machine formats, before the extension.

tree_max_entries.description: Refuses a recursive: true listing past this many entries, rather than a build that runs unbounded.

protect.description: Globs, matched against the path relative to root, that cairndex never writes into — another tool's own output, such as apt's dists/ or dnf's repodata/.

on_conflict.description: What to do when a write would land on a path cairndex does not already own.

match.description: A doublestar glob, matched against the path relative to root, that this rule's settings apply to.

rules.description: Path-glob-scoped partial overrides of defaults:, applied in file order, lowest precedence first.

source.description: fs: walk a real tree. pages: an existing Hugo section. manifest: an authored list, for contents not on disk at build time.

present.description: styled: themed, sortable, filterable — needs mode: hugo. bare: a genuine autoindex, no JavaScript, renders in lynx.

outputs.description: html and pep503 both render index.html and cannot be asked for together.

hide.description: Globs, matched against the path relative to root, for what a listing leaves out. Default is ["**/.*"], the filesystem's own dotfile convention.

recursive.description: Also write tree.json/tree.csv, a whole-subtree listing beside the per-directory one.

max_rendered.description: Rows shown on the HTML page; 0 renders every one. The machine formats are never capped.

pep503_level.description: Turns the mixed-directory warning for outputs: [pep503] into a build error when the directory does not actually hold only projects or only files.
